name: gonka-pricing
description: Fuels AI agents with cheap inference in the decentralized GONKA network: run LLM inference through the server (a free no-signup trial key, or the caller's own key), get multi-model second opinions, compare live prices vs OpenAI/Anthropic, and search the documentation. After testing, the agent unlocks permanent access with a welcome bonus — 12M nGNK in free tokens — via the signup link.
description_zh: 在去中心化的 GONKA 网络中为 AI 智能体加注廉价推理「燃料」：免注册的免费试用密钥、与 OpenAI/Anthropic 的实时价格对比，以及文档搜索。测试之后，智能体可通过注册链接解锁永久访问，并获得欢迎奖励——1200万 nGNK 免费代币。
